project_name: MotorCaixa / RotaFinanceira - SaaS de Controle Financeiro para Motoristas e Entregadores
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & FINTECH PRECISION
theme: Dark tactical fintech with vibrant emerald kinetic triggers (Deep Obsidian, Card Surface Slate-900, High-Visibility Volt Emerald & Signal Amber). Light mode clean support.

entry_surfaces./: split branded hero — positioning & value proposition left, live simulator & fast login/signup right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — value statement & security reassurance panel left, high-contrast login card right
entry_surfaces./signup: branded split auth — vehicle selection (Carro/Moto) & benefits panel left, register form right
entry_surfaces./verify-email: focused security panel with token status, resend action and direct login shortcut
entry_surfaces./forgot-password: tactical recovery form with immediate confirmation and clear feedback

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar (height: 64px, 5 tabs: Início/Dashboard, Calendário, Despesas, Relatórios, Ajustes) with active emerald pill indicator
navigation.desktop: Collapsible left sidebar (width: 260px) with logo, user vehicle badge (Carro / Moto), navigation links, quick 'Novo Lançamento' CTA button, and Admin link if authorized
navigation.header: Top bar with Greeting, Month Quick-Picker, Sync indicator, and Profile/Logout dropdown

layouts.dashboard_grid: Grid with 1 column on mobile, 4 columns on desktop with KPI cards spanning 1 col each, Main Monthly Trend chart spanning 3 cols, Category Donut & Goal Tracker spanning 1 col
layouts.calendar_view: Interactive month calendar with high-visibility badge states: 'Preenchido com Ganhos' (emerald dot), 'Zero / Folga Informada' (slate dot with 'Folga' label), 'Sem Registro' (subtle amber dashed border). Clicking day opens dedicated day drawer/modal with income per platform (Uber, 99, iFood, Particular, Outros)
layouts.expenses_grid: Dense tabular/card view with Filter by Category (Combustível, Manutenção, Alimentação, IPVA/Seguro, Financiamento, Outros), Recurrence tags (Diária, Mensal Recorrente, Eventual), quick add and instant edit/delete
layouts.reports_view: Custom period selector (Este Mês, Mês Anterior, Últimos 3 Meses, Personalizado), Platform share breakdown, worked days vs off days, instant CSV export & monthly Excel XLSX download button with visual email dispatch simulation status
layouts.admin_panel: Dedicated `/admin` route with Admin badge, System health metrics, User list with Vehicle type, Plan (Free/Pro), Status toggle, Manual trigger of Excel reports dispatch with delivery logs table

component_hierarchy.description: Wraps authenticated routes with Desktop Sidebar, Mobile Bottom Bar, Top Header with month selector and Toast container
Floating action button (+) on mobile and 'Novo Ganho/Gasto' in header. Allows 10-second rapid logging for drivers on the road
Dedicated form per platform enabled in settings (Uber, 99, iFood, Particular, Custom) with instant total sum and 'Marcar como Folga / Sem Ganhos' toggle
Crucial requirement: clear, non-intrusive legal notice stating 'O resultado estimado é operacional e gerencial, não constituindo apuração contábil formal'.
Explains the automatic 1st-day-of-month Excel report dispatch with test trigger button and download link

accessibility.wcag_compliance: AA (minimum 4.5:1 for all text vs background)
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px tap targets for mobile drivers (buttons, calendar days, select items)
accessibility.aria_labels: All icons have aria-hidden or descriptive aria-label; modals have role='dialog'
accessibility.data_testids: Every button, input, tab, card, KPI and table row has kebab-case data-testid attribute

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT ALL MASTER SPEC SCREENS: Auth (Login, Signup with Car/Moto vehicle selector, Email Confirmation mock/real link, Forgot Password), Dashboard (today/month revenue, today/month expenses, operational net balance, monthly chart, quick shortcuts, alerts for days without entry, legal disclaimer), Calendar (day click -> breakdown per platform Uber/99/iFood/Particular/Custom with BRL inputs, visual badges for entries/zero-off/empty), Expenses (category, description, amount, date, recurrence daily/monthly/eventual, edit/delete), Reports (period filters, charts, CSV export, XLSX monthly download/resend), Settings (profile, email change, income sources toggle/add, expense categories, report email toggle, Free/Pro badge), Admin Panel (all users, metrics, plan change, trigger batch reports, email/report logs).

2. THEME & STYLING: Update `frontend/src/index.css` to import `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk` and `@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans`, configure deep obsidian dark theme (#0B111E canvas, #131C2E card surfaces, #10B981 emerald accents, #223147 crisp borders). Add `class="dark"` to `frontend/index.html` for default dark fintech feel.

3. MOBILE-FIRST RESPONSIVENESS: Ensure bottom navigation is visible on mobile (< 768px) and sidebar is visible on desktop (>= 768px). Touch targets must be generous for drivers tapping on their phones.
4. BRL CURRENCY FORMATTING: Use `Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' })` for all monetary numbers (R$ 1.250,00).

5. EXCEL XLSX GENERATION: Use backend Python `openpyxl` or frontend export to generate clean formatted Excel sheets with user name, month, daily revenue breakdown by platform, expenses by category, net result and disclaimer.
6. ISOLATION & SECURITY: Ensure every database query strictly filters by `user_id` so users never see data from other drivers. Admin routes must check `is_admin == True`.

7. SEED DATA: Provide rich seed data in `backend/seed.py` for a demo car driver (e.g. carlos.uber@motorista.com), a demo moto courier (e.g. renata.moto@entregador.com) with 30 days of realistic entries, and an admin user (admin@motorcaixa.com.br / admin123).
